newsitem.title: USA: Waste Management to name LeMay CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Waste Management to name LeMay CEO - WSJ.

text.p: Waste Management Inc is expected to announce Monday that it has chosen Ronald LeMay as its new chairman and chief executive, The Wall Street Journal said.
LeMay is Sprint Corp's president and chief operating officer.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said the 51-year-old LeMay will succeed Dean Buntrock, 66, Waste Management's chairman and interim CEO.
The Journal said its information for the story came from "individuals close to the situation."
Waste Management has been searching for a leader for five months, the paper said.
LeMay apparently decided to quit Sprint because its current chairman and CEO does not plan to step down any time soon, the article said.
LeMay's selection marks the first time the company has reached outside its own ranks and its industry for a new leader, the article said.
